stories.title: Previsão do tempo hoje para Brasília (DF): sol com muitas nuvens; pancadas de chuva à tarde e à noite

en.title: Weather forecast today for Brasília (DF): sunny with many clouds; rain showers in the afternoon and night
en.summary: Brasília is expected to have sunny weather with many clouds in the morning, followed by rain showers and thunderstorms in the afternoon and evening. Temperatures will range from 19°C to 30°C.

stories.title: 'Gracias eternas': imprensa internacional celebra despedida de Messi

en.title: 'Gracias eternas': international press celebrates Messi's farewell
en.summary: International media celebrated Lionel Messi's farewell from the Argentine national team at a historic event on Tuesday, emphasizing his lasting legacy and impact on football.

stories.title: Incêndio de grandes proporções atinge fábrica no Jabaquara, na zona sul de São Paulo

en.title: Large-scale fire hits factory in Jabaquara, south zone of São Paulo
en.summary: A large-scale fire struck a factory located in the Jabaquara neighborhood in the south zone of São Paulo.

stories.title: PSDB tem maioria de diretórios estaduais com posição pró-Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: PSDB has majority of state directories with pro-Flávio Bolsonaro position
en.summary: PSDB's national president Aécio Neves is consulting the party's state directories about its positioning in the presidential runoff election.

stories.title: Imprensa internacional se derrete por Messi em despedida da Argentina: ‘O melhor até o último dia’

en.title: International press melts for Messi in Argentina farewell: 'The best until the last day'
en.summary: International media outlets praised Messi's performance in his final match for Argentina, highlighting his excellence throughout his career with the national team.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que fim da reeleição não é para volta do pai à Presidência em 2030

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro says ending reelection is not for father's return to presidency in 2030
en.summary: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro stated he supports ending presidential reelection to enable new political leaders, denying it aims to facilitate his father's potential election in 2030.

stories.title: Mega-Sena acumula para R$ 100 milhões; confira os números sorteados

en.title: Mega-Sena accumulates to 100 million reais; check the drawn numbers
en.summary: No lottery players matched all six numbers in Mega-Sena drawing 3,067, causing the jackpot to accumulate to an estimated 100 million reais for the next draw. Partial winners received smaller prizes.

stories.title: Messi se emociona em hino da Argentina na sua despedida da seleção; assista

en.title: Messi gets emotional singing Argentina anthem in his farewell from the national team; watch
en.summary: Messi became emotional while singing the Argentine national anthem during his final appearance for the national team.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz ter maioria para fazer presidentes do Senado e Câmara e mudar a Constituição

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro says he has majority to make Senate and Chamber presidents and change the Constitution
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro claims to have sufficient parliamentary support to elect leaders of the Senate and Chamber and pursue constitutional amendments.

stories.title: Após acumular nesta terça, Mega-Sena concurso 3068 vai sortear R$ 100 milhões

en.title: After accumulating on Tuesday, Mega-Sena draw 3068 will award R$ 100 million
en.summary: No winners correctly guessed all six numbers in the previous Mega-Sena lottery draw, causing the jackpot to accumulate to an estimated R$ 100 million for the next drawing.

stories.title: Os grandes momentos de Messi pela seleção da Argentina

en.title: The great moments of Messi for Argentina's national team
en.summary: Lionel Messi retired from Argentina's national team as a legend, having won the World Cup once and the Copa América twice, scoring 126 goals throughout his career with the team.

stories.title: Incêndio atinge fábrica em SP; 18 viaturas dos Bombeiros são acionadas

en.title: Fire reaches factory in SP; 18 Fire Department vehicles are dispatched
en.summary: A large-scale fire broke out at a factory in the Jabaquara neighborhood in southern São Paulo, prompting emergency responders to deploy multiple fire trucks.

stories.title: China: Reservas cambiais caíram para US$ 3,4 trilhões em setembro

en.title: China: Foreign exchange reserves fell to US$ 3.4 trillion in September
en.summary: China's foreign exchange reserves declined in September as expected by economists, driven by negative valuation effects according to data released by the People's Bank of China.

stories.title: Codelco investiga novos indícios de irregularidades no cálculo da produção de cobre no Chile

en.title: Codelco investigates new indications of irregularities in copper production calculation in Chile
en.summary: Codelco is investigating evidence that copper production may have been counted twice in 2024 and 2025, potentially inflating reported output from the Ministro Hales and Salvador mines. The company has referred findings to prosecutors and hired Ernst & Young to assess the scope and financial impact.

stories.title: Rubio pede à Rússia que compartilhe informação sobre morte na Sibéria

en.title: Rubio asks Russia to share information about death in Siberia
en.summary: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio called on Russia to provide more information regarding a research laboratory worker's death in Siberia, with initial suspicion pointing to accidental plague contamination.

stories.title: TSE marca julgamento do caso Garotinho que pode mudar eleição no Rio

en.title: TSE schedules ruling on Garotinho case that could change Rio election
en.summary: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court will decide whether former governor Anthony Garotinho can withdraw an appeal challenging his candidacy rejection, a ruling that could determine Rio de Janeiro's gubernatorial election outcome.

stories.title: Paes pede que ministro do TSE mantenha votos de Garotinho no cálculo do segundo turno

en.title: Paes asks TSE minister to maintain Garotinho's votes in runoff calculation
en.summary: Eduardo Paes's coalition requested that Brazil's Superior Electoral Court keep the 274,411 votes received by former governor Anthony Garotinho in the calculation determining whether a runoff will occur in Rio de Janeiro's gubernatorial race.
